name: DCA-B1-01 · AI Customer Support Agent (answers from your facts, escalates when unsure)

parameters.content:
## 🤖 AI Customer Support Agent
**Reads the question → answers from YOUR facts → escalates when unsure.**

### Setup (about 20 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → fill `knowledgeBase` with your real policies, products,
   delivery times and refund terms. **This is the whole job** — the agent
   can only be as accurate as what you put here.
2. Set `aiEndpoint` and `aiModel` for your provider.
3. Add your API key as a **Header Auth** credential on **🧠 Ask the model**.
4. Attach SMTP to **📧 Send the reply**.
5. Point your contact form / inbox automation at the Production URL.
6. Run with `autoReply: false` for a week — it drafts everything and sends
   nothing, so you can read what it *would* have said.

⚠️ **Start with `autoReply: false`.** Read a week of drafts before you let
it talk to customers unsupervised.

### 🛑 Why it refuses rather than guesses
Most AI support templates reply to everything. That works until a
customer asks about something the business never wrote down — and the
model invents a refund window, a feature, a delivery promise.

**The customer then holds you to it.**

So this agent must answer *only* from `knowledgeBase`, must report a
confidence score, and must set an escalate flag when it is unsure.
Below the threshold → a human sees it.

A slower correct answer beats an instant invented one.

### 🚨 Always escalated, whatever the confidence
- refunds and chargebacks
- payment and billing disputes
- legal, tax, GDPR, privacy demands
- account access and deletion
- anything with an angry tone

These carry money or obligation. Confidence is irrelevant — a human
decides. Edit the list in **⚙️ Config → alwaysEscalate**.

### 💰 Running cost
Roughly **$0.001–$0.01 per question**, depending on model and knowledge
base size. A hundred questions a day is a few dollars a month.

The buyer supplies their own API key — **no key ships in this template**,
and the build gate rejects any template that contains one.

nodes.name: 💬 Customer question
nodes.notes: POST {email, message, name?, subject?}. Wire your contact form or inbox here.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: knowledgeBase is the whole job. Accuracy here IS the agent's accuracy.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 🔍 Pre-triage
nodes.notes: Deterministic guardrails run before any model call — cheaper and not overridable by the model.

nodes.name: 🧠 Ask the model

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: $json.__config.aiModel,
  max_tokens: $json.__config.maxTokens,
  system: 'You are a customer support agent for ' + $json.__config.storeName + '.

'
    + 'ANSWER ONLY FROM THE FACTS BELOW. If the facts do not cover the question, you MUST set '
    + '"escalate": true and leave the reply empty. Never guess a policy, price, timeframe or feature. '
    + 'Inventing an answer creates an obligation the business did not agree to.

'
    + '=== FACTS ===
' + $json.__config.knowledgeBase + '
=== END FACTS ===

'
    + 'Reply with STRICT JSON only, no markdown fence:
'
    + '{"reply": "<plain text answer to the customer>", "confidence": <0..1>, "escalate": <true|false>, "reason": "<short note for the human>"}

'
    + 'Set confidence below 0.75 whenever the facts only partly cover the question.',
  messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Customer: ' + $json.name + ' <' + $json.email + '>
Subject: ' + $json.subject + '

' + $json.message } ]
}) }}

nodes.notes: Add your API key as a Header Auth credential (x-api-key for Anthropic, Authorization for OpenAI).

nodes.name: 📖 Read the answer
nodes.notes: Unparseable output escalates instead of sending nonsense to a customer.

nodes.name: 📧 Send the reply

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.subject ? 'Re: ' + $json.subject : ('Re: your question — ' + $json.__config.storeName) }}
parameters.html:
={{ '
' + '

' + $json.aiReply + '

' + '

If this did not answer your question, just reply and a person will pick it up.

' + '
' + '

' + $json.__config.storeName + '

' + '
' }}

nodes.notes: Only reached when the agent is confident AND autoReply is on.

nodes.name: 🙋 Hand to a human
nodes.notes: Sends you the question plus a draft. Editing a draft is far faster than writing from scratch.

nodes.name: 📨 Notify the human
nodes.notes: Swap for Slack or Telegram if you prefer.

nodes.name: 📒 Support log
nodes.notes: Review weekly. A high escalation rate is a knowledge-base gap, not an agent failure.

nodes.name: 🚨 Handle failure
nodes.notes: Structured failure record. Wire to your alert channel.
